caption: Near absolute zero, fixed nearest-neighbor wiring, fast gates (tens of ns). Biggest bottleneck: wiring/control-line density as qubit count grows.
High vacuum + lasers, all-to-all connectivity within a trap, slower gates (μs). Biggest bottleneck: scaling one chain, or reliably linking multiple traps.
Room temperature, flexible waveguide routing, fast transmission but sometimes-probabilistic gates. Biggest bottleneck: photon loss, with no direct error-correction analog.
Room temperature, reconfigurable via movable tweezers, gate speed tied to Rydberg excitation. Biggest bottleneck: gate fidelity, atom loss, and rearrangement risk.
